title: NASA's Lucy spacecraft reaches Trojan asteroid region
excerpt: The spacecraft has traveled more than 2.2 billion miles since its launch on Oct. 16, 2021.
bodyHtml:
NASA announced on October 28, 2026, that its Lucy spacecraft has entered a region of primitive solar-system bodies known as the Jupiter Trojan asteroids. NASA stated that having traveled more than 2.2 billion miles since it launched on Oct. 16, 2021, NASA's Lucy is the first spacecraft to enter this region.

Mission engineers know that Lucy is approaching Jupiter's Lagrange point 4 by tracking Lucy's location through the spacecraft's radio signals and images of surrounding stars. This region is one of two large and unexplored islands of stability, where thousands of asteroids share Jupiter's orbit around the Sun.

Lucy will visit asteroids in both regions, and Lucy's first encounter with the Trojan Eurybates will occur on Aug. 11, 2027.
topic: NASA’s Lucy Reaches Trojan Asteroid Region 5 Years After Launch
